rules.description: Long browser freshness only for successful hashed asset responses
rules.expression: (http.host in {"tournstack.com" "www.tournstack.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/versioned/") and http.response.code eq 200)

rules.description: Never retain missing, redirected or failed versioned asset responses
rules.expression: (http.host in {"tournstack.com" "www.tournstack.com"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/versioned/") and http.response.code ne 200)
